description: For a well-order of regular cardinal order type and uncountable cofinality, any function regressive on a stationary set has a stationary fiber.
signature:
exists_isStationary_preimage_singleton.{v} {α : Type v} {s : Set α} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  [IsRegularCardinalOrder α] {f : α → α} (hα : Order.cof α ≠ Cardinal.aleph0) (hs : IsStationary s)
  (hf : ∀ x ∈ s, f x < x) : ∃ a, IsStationary (s ∩ f ⁻¹' {a})
